preamble: The shift from the close-mid back rounded vowel [o] to an unrounded back/central vowel [ʌ] is a form of unrounding and lowering under vowel reduction. Its best-known case is Russian akanye, where unstressed /o/ in the syllable immediately before the stress is realized as [ɐ], traditionally also transcribed [ʌ].

examples.note: Akanye: unstressed /o/ immediately before the stress merges with /a/ as [ɐ]~[ʌ]
